episodes.synopsis: The Pumpkin Scissors unit gets help from an unexpected source in dealing with a group of rogue soldiers.
episodes.title: The Invisible 9

episodes.synopsis: Randel is officially inducted into the Pumpkin Scissors unit, just in time for Section III to have to deal with a Viscount who has been mistreating his subjects.
episodes.title: War Relief Unit

episodes.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors are sent to rebuild a tunnel, and convince reluctant villagers to join their cause.
episodes.title: For That is a Precious Thing

episodes.synopsis: Having become distrustful of Randel, Martis begins investigating his past.
episodes.title: The Cracking Portrait

episodes.synopsis: Martis and Oreldo investigate more about Randel while he is in the hospital.
episodes.title: The Frivolous Men

episodes.synopsis: Randel and Alice try to find the mother of an abandoned baby.
episodes.title: A Fruitful Time

episodes.synopsis: Alice gets a day off to meet her fiance, and the rest of the Pumpkin Scissors must look for missing supplies.
episodes.title: The Lead And The Follow

episodes.synopsis: The Pumpkin Scissors race to deliver vital supplies in a frozen wasteland.
episodes.title: Burning Snowfields

episodes.synopsis: Ladies man Oreldo helps a desperate woman come to terms with her past.
episodes.title: Woman of the Morning Mist

episodes.synopsis: The meaning behind the Pumpkin Scissors' title is finally revealed as Stecchin explains its creation to Randel.
episodes.title: Pumpkin and Scissors

episodes.title: Quiet Movement

episodes.synopsis: Alice agrees to cooperate with her kidnappers and is released; little do they know what someone has in store for them.
episodes.title: The Unseen Pain

episodes.synopsis: Martis meets with a foreign princess.
episodes.title: Rough, but Delicious

episodes.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors must deal with drug dealers while moving homeless people from the sewers.
episodes.title: The Flame Still Burns

episodes.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors continues to fight the drug dealers, and their situation is complicated by a person with a flamethrower.
episodes.title: The Decision To Stray

episodes.synopsis: Alice must unleash her special weapon to finish the fight against the drug dealers.
episodes.title: The One Who Tears to Pieces

episodes.synopsis: Alice fights the Claymores while Randel fights Hans.
episodes.title: The Yet Unrescued Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Stecchin attempts to cheer up Randel, who has been depressed since the last mission.
episodes.title: Small War Potential

episodes.synopsis: Alice goes to a ball with her sisters while the rest of Pumpkin Scissors gives rations out to the homeless.
episodes.title: Trick in Treat

episodes.synopsis: The ball is invaded by an angry mob.
episodes.title: Enter the Performers

episodes.synopsis: Marquis sends his two bodyguards at Alice when she challenges him to a duel.
episodes.title: The Puppet and the Idol

episodes.synopsis: Alice must deal with the mob and her opponents, and Randel again looks for a reason to fight.
episodes.title: The Isolated Scales

episodes.synopsis: Everyone witnesses Alice's duel, and the military prepares to raid the mansion.
episodes.title: And Then There Was a Sweet Trap

episodes.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors is quickly running out of time to find a solution before the mansion is attacked.
episodes.title: Soldiers, Commoners, Nobles
